label: Film and format
description: Photographic film stocks, camera formats, digital capture looks, video media, and historical processes.
notes: Named film stocks, capture formats, camera looks, video media, and historical photographic processes belong here. camera.lens owns optical effects and focus; lighting.studio owns lighting setups. Values are short noun phrases after “shot on”; paper and plate names stand for the finished photographic process. Generic camera entries include a characteristic capture treatment where useful, and the looks describe recognizable visual cues rather than guaranteed camera properties. Historical and discontinued media remain available for scenes of any era, and a film format does not prescribe a color stock.
